section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining relationships between interoceptive awareness (IA) and body image in community adults. The study included 646 British adults (447 women, aged 18-76 years) who completed an online survey with multiple instruments including the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), the Multidimensional Assessment of Interoceptive Awareness (MAIA), and other body image measures. Hierarchical regressions revealed significant predictive relationships between IA dimensions and all five facets of body image after controlling for sex, BMI, and age.
